works.title: aynse
works.short: a resilient Python adapter for historical, archive and live National Stock Exchange data.
works.long: A typed Python library and CLI for fetching NSE stock, index, derivative, valuation, bhavcopy, bulk-deal and option-chain data. It combines HTTP/2 connection pooling, adaptive batching, streaming parsers, rate limiting, retry jitter and a circuit breaker in a small public API.

works.title: uasset lens
works.short: inspect, diff and safely patch fixed-width properties in Unreal Engine assets without opening the editor.
works.long: A dependency-free Python GUI, CLI and API for reading Unreal Engine 5 .uasset files. It can inventory large Content folders, capture reviewable snapshots, diff asset drift and apply length-preserving edits with automatic backups and verification.

works.title: heartsync
works.short: direct, encrypted two-person playback sync for videos already stored on each Mac.
works.long: A native macOS app that mirrors play, pause and seek operations without relaying either viewer's media. It measures clock offset and latency, corrects timeline drift, supports browser, VLC and QuickTime control, and uses short-lived HMAC-authenticated AES-GCM rooms.

works.title: tv relay
works.short: a cross-platform Android TV remote with typing, app launching, sideloading and screen mirroring.
works.long: An Electron desktop remote for Android and smart TVs. It combines ADB control with an optional native remote path, remembers several devices, discovers installed apps, types from the computer keyboard, sideloads APKs and packages the matching scrcpy runtime for dependable mirroring.

works.title: artsaver
works.short: an ambient desktop gallery that endlessly shuffles public art from four museum collections.
works.long: A cross-platform Electron screensaver with museum and immersive display modes, curated playlists, favourites, history, offline caching, procedural room tone and a small local server that can extend the gallery to a smart TV.

works.title: UE Camera2 plugin
works.short: direct Android Camera2 access for Unreal Engine and Meta Quest standalone projects.
works.long: An Unreal Engine plugin that streams Camera2 frames into a Texture2D and exposes deterministic left/right selection, calibrated intrinsics, lens data and camera-in-headset transforms to Blueprints. It includes Quest 3 calibration fallbacks and render-thread texture updates.

works.title: UE MCP bridge
works.short: an Unreal Engine 5.5 C++ bridge exposing more than 185 editor operations through MCP.
works.long: A plugin-only WebSocket integration that packages UE-MCP for an Unreal Engine 5.5 workflow. It connects MCP clients to editor tooling across actors, assets, materials, Blueprints, animation, Niagara, PCG, UI, audio, cinematics and gameplay systems.

works.title: winhopper
works.short: a fast Windows sidebar for switching, grouping, searching and pinning open windows.
works.long: A portable .NET window switcher inspired by Arc's sidebar. It can be summoned by hotkey or screen edge, groups windows into workspaces, keeps favourite apps pinned and supports keyboard-first filtering and selection.

works.title: dumbex
works.short: streaming literal or regex extraction for logs too large to inspect comfortably.
works.long: A Python CLI and Textual TUI for extracting matching lines or trigger-led blocks from multi-million-line logs. The core streams input rather than loading it into memory and supports reusable JSON rule sets.

works.title: export just diff
works.short: a PowerShell utility for exporting only the files changed across recent Git history.
works.long: A small hand-off tool that collects files changed over the last N commits or since a chosen commit, preserving repository-relative paths in a clean output directory.

works.title: better unreal
works.short: a compact collection of Unreal Engine Blueprint and C++ workflow utilities.
works.long: Reusable Unreal helpers for file IO, hexadecimal and floating-point conversion, CRC-16 checksums and practical Blueprint calculations. The repository is organised as small pieces that can be copied into an existing project independently.

works.title: better windows
works.short: a PowerShell front end for setting up a fresh Windows installation safely and quickly.
works.long: A utility for installing development, gaming and media essentials, fetching ffmpeg and yt-dlp, adding useful shell integrations and removing optional preinstalled applications without overwriting the existing PATH.

works.title: unreal–unity communication
works.short: paired Unreal and Unity projects configured for direct TCP and UDP communication.
works.long: A practical reference bundle for exchanging messages between the two engines. It includes configurable server and client components, editor-facing status controls and small Windows command-line helpers for testing packets outside either runtime.

works.title: Unity Standard Assets ported
works.short: a preserved, modular download of Unity's retired Standard Assets packages.
works.long: An archival split of the Unity 2017 Standard Assets into independent .unitypackage files for 2D, cameras, characters, cross-platform input, effects, environments, particles, prototyping, utilities and vehicles.

works.title: seek
works.short: an infinitely navigable inspiration canvas built from a changing public image index.
works.long: A spatial image browser that scatters a shuffled collection across an expanding canvas. A small Flask service discovers and caches the source index, while an allow-listed proxy lets the static front end explore and download images without leaking arbitrary fetch access. The former custom-domain deployment is currently offline; the source remains public.

works.title: better unity
works.short: minimal unity extension suite that aims to be modular and non-intrusive.
works.long: a collection of modifications and additions (scripts/prefabs) which enhance the overall flow of using the unity engine. features include inspector enhancements, transform tools, hierarchy improvements, debug utilities, vr scripts, navigation systems, and flow controllers. designed to be robust but minimal with modular architecture and minimal cross-dependencies.

works.title: cbfc cut lists explorer
works.short: modular way to explore/analyze cbfc's censorship and usual practices
works.long:
github repository.
a fully searchable database of all the cut lists of the cbfc. search by the cuts, film names, film language and more. a fast database is initialized with the data from the cbfc website - allowing for fast searching and filtering.

works.title: Unlearn
works.short: A 2D puzzle-platformer that pits you against your own keyboard.
works.long: Keys change behaviour forcing you to un-learn muscle memory while unfolding a metafictional narrative. Built with Unity, this game explores the concept of adaptive controls and player conditioning, creating a unique gameplay experience that challenges traditional input expectations.

works.title: render buddy
works.short: unreal engine toolkit for remote render monitoring and batch processing.
works.long: a handy toolkit designed to bridge the gap between individual/small teams and enterprise-level unreal engine capabilities. features include remote render control via firebase, batch rendering from csv files, new process rendering, and real-time status monitoring through a web dashboard. aimed at indie and mid-level teams to leverage advanced rendering workflows without technical complexity.

works.title: 2D-3D Floor-Plan Generator
works.short: Turns CAD floor-plans into textured 3D VR-ready models.
works.long:
A tool that attempts to save time for architects in having to visualize house/floor plans for clients in 3D.

Elaborating on the problem statement a little more, architects usually design house plans in 2D using some CAD software. These CAD files (.dwg,.cad,.dxf) are great and serve most realistic purposes but home owners like to visualize their homes in a proper 3D manner before settling down on one. This in turn, entails the architects having to make 3D models themselves or having to ask people to make 3D models for them.

The manual 3D modelling usually takes up about 1-2 hours of the architects time. The solution cuts down on the time required from prep from 1-2 hours down to 5-10 minutes and automates most of the 3D generation.

The user imports the 2D floor plan from a simple .exe and then in turn receive a complete 3D model that is viewable in VR right out the gate with proper materials/textures assigned to it. Uses Python as the backend to parse the CAD files and then uses Unreal to swap in models/textures/material from a huge library of presets.

works.title: isro's gaganyaan vr simulator
works.short: an end-to-end vr simulator for isro's gaganyaan mission
works.long: a fully-fledged vr simulator for isro's gaganyaan mission. the simulator is a multi-user training system that allows for training of astronauts in a safe and controlled environment. developer in collaboration with ISRO during my time at parallax labs - simulates mission phases with an ability to ingest actual simulation data - malleable physics, time and space-based physics.

works.title: the everything bagel
works.short: a website making use of various datasets mostly for fun but could be utilized for productivity.
works.long:
A website consisting of various sections pertaining to multiple functionalities. Inspired by the movie Everything Everywhere All at Once by Daniel Kwan and Daniel Scheinert. The whole idea is a combination of various online datasets (all mostly through open source APIs) into a meaningful format - making a fun and mostly silly yet slightly productive experience.

Main Components:

1. Art: Query and fetch art pieces from major museums (Metropolitan Museum of Modern Art and Chicago Art Museum) - over 700k art pieces available for browsing.

2. World Information: Real-time world data including IP/email/DNS geolocation, world registered domains search, forex rates, and Indian postal codes lookup.

3. Every Day is Special: Historical events, notable births and deaths for any given day to make dull days more interesting.

4. Analytics and Data: Name-based estimations (age/gender/nationality guessing) and unified metadata fetching for any website URL.

5. Religious Stuff: Random verses from three holy books: Bhagavad Gita, Bible, and Quran.

6. Silly Things: Random cat/dog facts and images, plus fox and duck sections for entertainment.

works.title: Saaya
works.short: Psychological horror game set in Himachal Pradesh.
works.long: A psychological horror game with a focus on ambiance. You explore a private ranch in Himachal, and eventually piece together the story. Ambient narrative horror inspired by PT; uncover the tragic truth behind your missing son. TW: Tantric cults, human sacrifices.

works.title: realistic colors visualizer
works.short: unreal-engine powered colors visualizer made for birla opus.
works.long: a unreal engine front end that interfaces with hardware knobs and a controller simulateneously and allows for real-time color visualization of about ~2300 colors on varied houses and very seamless customer onboarding and analytics. deployed across 10+ locations in india [mumbai, delhi, kolkata, etc].

works.title: gamejams tidbits
works.short: a collection of gamejams projects/tiny projects.
works.long:
A collection of small game projects and jam entries showcasing rapid prototyping and creative experimentation:

1. zzz…: 48-hour jam game where you clear caffeine from Bob's brain so he can sleep. You roam neural pathways eliminating caffeine molecules in this unique biological adventure.

2. All Mans Space: CRT-styled arcade shooter built in just 93 minutes. Dodge and shoot missiles to rack up a high score in this retro homage with authentic vintage aesthetics.

3. Snakes and Ladders: Classic board game re-imagined on screen, built in 46 minutes. Features simple dice mechanics with quick colourful visuals for a modern take on the timeless game.

4. Tower Power: One-week tower-defence project inspired by Brackeys tutorials. Balance economy and turret synergy to survive incoming waves in this strategic defense game.

works.title: MR HMG Simulator
works.short: Mixed-reality heavy-machine-gun simulator for Varjo-XR 3.
works.long:
A MR based Machine Gun simulator made for the Varjo XR-3. The experience is setup with a green screen on which the MR content is displayed. Features a real gun from which trigger, position data is received and reflected inside of the simulator [serial ports].

The specifications have to be as generic as possible because of a signed NDA: The ballistics have been coded to simulate real gun's ballistics as much as possible. From the gun's specifications to the bullet's specifications are all accurately done.

The bullet has a specified ballistic coefficient: takes in form factor, mass, diameter etc. The gun also can have additional spread, different fire modes, switching of the ammo/bullet-types depending on the configuration.

Has multiple modes of training too, from zeroing to tactical marksmanship all in accordance to the [redacted] Army specifications. The full interface also has CRC-16 checksums at both the receiver and the sender to ensure full data integrity.

The simulator features multiple realistic environments and weather conditions including snowy mountain terrain, temperate grasslands, rocky desert landscapes, and arctic conditions with dynamic weather effects like snowfall. These diverse environmental settings provide comprehensive training scenarios for different operational conditions and tactical situations.


Plus a lot of 'more' specific and intricate trainings which I unfortunately can't reveal but have been coded in C++/Blueprints using Unreal Engine.

works.title: VR Fire Safety Training
works.short: Interactive VR module teaching extinguisher usage.
works.long:
A VR-based fire safety training simulator which trains people on various phases of extinguishing a fire.

Has multiple modules that teach things ranging from evacuation to extinguishing different types of fires and which extinguishers to use.

works.title: OpenGL Experiments
works.short: Graphics algorithms and demos in C/OpenGL - graphics experiments.
works.long: Custom rasteriser, shader playground and real-time lighting maths.

works.title: blender open render queue
works.short: simple, lightweight render queuing tool/batch renderer for blender.
works.long: an open-source render queue for blender that acts as a wrapper around the blender cli. designed to be a simple solution for queuing up renders and executing them in the background. features include automatic blender executable detection, blend file queue management, and background rendering capabilities. created as an alternative to paid and convoluted solutions.

works.title: wusic — Minimal Music Player
works.short: Distraction-free music player born from personal frustrations with typical music apps.
works.long:
A music player designed from personal experience with choice paralysis (always ending up with Kanye!) and distracting music interfaces. Built for focused work/study sessions with thoughtful UX choices:

- Swipe-based album view instead of overwhelming lists, forcing more deliberate music choices
- Intentional long-press to play mechanism that discourages frequent switching
- Single-click dark mode and fullscreen toggles (no more digging through menus!)
- Clean, consistent aesthetic with minimal UI elements

Features offline music library management with custom sorting and integrated lofi-music streams. The entire design philosophy stems from real frustrations with existing players, creating something that's both visually pleasing and mindfully engineered to reduce distractions.

works.title: small tools & early experiments
works.short: the useful fragments, learning projects and archives that do not need a full portfolio case study.
works.long: The longer tail of the public repository archive: a Keras/OpenCV facial-expression recogniser; a genetic-algorithm self-driving simulation; CoinSentience and TradingView studies; Python 202020's screen-break reminders; an online-results change notifier; IndiaBlock filter rules; colour detection and colour-data formatters; ADB transfer helpers; Unity and Unreal starter projects; interaction research; 360 projection test content; small networking prototypes; and early C, Java, web and cryptography exercises. They remain public as working notes and historical snapshots rather than being inflated into standalone case studies.

works.title: 81mm mortar simulator
works.short: a fully-fledged simulator - with accurate physics and realistic ballistics - multi-user training
works.long: deployed at several infantry schools. featuers are immense and encapsulate every facet of a mortar platoon. there are several other QoL features and a robust error-free mathematical foundation for all calculations.

works.title: Shiva
works.short: 3D Hack-n-Slash/RPG inspired by Hindu mythology - derives ancient mythology to form a fun combat system and level design.
works.long: Multi-chapter action RPG built with Unity URP, exploring timelines through stylised combat.
